preconditions.description: The input integer x is odd.
The input integer x is within the range [3, 999999].

postconditions.description: The number of operations q does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= val <= 5 * 10**18 for val in blackboard_numbers)
postconditions.description: All numbers written on the blackboard (including initial x and results of operations) are within the range [0, 5*10^18].
The number 1 is present on the blackboard after all operations.

postconditions.expression: all(op_valid(op, blackboard_state_at_step) for op, blackboard_state_at_step in zip(operations, blackboard_states))
postconditions.description: Every operation uses two numbers that were already present on the blackboard at that step, and the result is correctly computed as either the sum or XOR of those two numbers.
